events.desc: The edict ending the third war of religion, granting the Huguenots four places of safety. Gregorian 18 August 1570. Its slow and contested execution is the subject of most of Cavriana's reporting through the autumn of 1570.
events.label: Peace of Saint-Germain-en-Laye

events.desc: Celebrated at Mézières. Gregorian 6 December 1570. Cavriana reports the wedding preparations through November and the new queen's reception at court in January.
events.label: Marriage of Charles IX and Elisabeth of Austria
labels: Marriage of Charles IX and Elisabeth of Austria

events.desc: The Holy League's naval victory over the Ottoman fleet. Gregorian 17 October 1571.
events.label: Battle of Lepanto

events.desc: The conclave following the death of Pius V, which elected Ugo Boncompagni. Gregorian 22–23 May 1572.
events.label: Election of Gregory XIII

events.desc: The match Cavriana had been reporting since 1570, celebrated in Paris six days before the massacre. Gregorian 28 August 1572.
events.label: Marriage of Henri de Navarre and Marguerite de Valois
labels: Marriage of Henri de Navarre and Marguerite de Valois

events.desc: The killing of Coligny and the Huguenot leadership in Paris, and afterwards in the provinces. Gregorian 3 September 1572.
events.label: Massacre of Saint Bartholomew's Day

events.desc: The royal army's assault on the Huguenot stronghold, lifted when Henri d'Anjou left to take the Polish crown. Gregorian 16 November 1572 to 16 July 1573.
events.label: Siege of La Rochelle

events.desc: The eight-month siege of the hilltop town, ended by famine. Gregorian 19 November 1572 to 29 August 1573.
events.label: Siege of Sancerre

events.desc: The first free royal election of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. Gregorian 21 May 1573.
events.label: Election of Henri d'Anjou as King of Poland
labels: Election of Henri d'Anjou as King of Poland

events.desc: The plot of the Duke of Alençon and the King of Navarre against Charles IX, discovered at Saint-Germain-en-Laye and reported by Cavriana on 6 March 1574. The precise span is uncertain; the dates given bracket the discovery.
events.label: Conspiracy of Saint-Germain
